meta.scope: South Korea (Republic of Korea) Batch 1 — Foundational statistical system and core national macro / labour / price / external series. Top-down start from Statistics Korea (KOSTAT) and Bank of Korea (BOK) under the locked expanded node definition. Definition frozen.
meta.strategy_note: Follows NEXT-COUNTRY-STRATEGY: open log entry day one, lock definition, begin with national statistical office catalogue + central bank, batch size ~12, rich notes. Japan closed; South Korea is the next high-priority Asia (excl. China/India) country.

candidates.title: Statistics Act (통계법)
candidates.description: Framework law governing the production, dissemination and use of official statistics in the Republic of Korea. Wholly amended in 2007 (Act No. 8387) and subsequently revised. Establishes the purpose of statistics as a public resource for rational decision-making, requires scientific methods to ensure accuracy, timeliness, consistency and impartiality, and provides the legal basis for designated statistics, statistical agencies and coordination by the Commissioner of Statistics Korea.
referenced_by: KOSTAT methodological documents and designation of official statistics
KOSIS portal and official statistical programmes
International assessments of Korea’s statistical system (IMF SDDS, OECD, UN)
candidates.notes: Foundational legal node, parallel to Japan’s Statistics Act 2007. Continuously cited as the authority for the reliability and coordination of official statistics. Qualifies under the expanded definition as a static instrument that is recurringly referenced in the operation of the entire statistical system.

candidates.title: Statistics Korea (KOSTAT) — national statistical office
candidates.description: Central government agency responsible for producing, coordinating and disseminating official statistics. Operates the KOSIS (Korean Statistical Information Service) portal, conducts major censuses and surveys, and designates official statistics under the Statistics Act.
referenced_by: All KOSTAT survey and census releases
National accounts and other agencies that rely on KOSTAT source data
candidates.notes: Institutional node. KOSTAT is the primary producer of demographic, labour, price, household and many economic statistics and the coordinator of the national statistical system.

candidates.title: Population and Housing Census (인구주택총조사)
candidates.description: Decennial (with inter-censal updates and register-based elements) complete enumeration of population, households and housing. Provides the benchmark for population estimates, sampling frames and a wide range of demographic and social statistics.
candidates.notes: Core demographic foundation. Used for population projections, electoral apportionment, sampling frames for household surveys, and as the reference for ageing and household-structure analysis. Parallel to Japan’s Population Census node.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index (소비자물가지수)
candidates.description: Monthly measure of changes in the prices of a fixed basket of consumer goods and services. Official inflation indicator used for monetary-policy assessment, indexation and real-income analysis.
candidates.notes: Primary price indicator. Continuously watched by the Bank of Korea, markets and policy makers. Base-year revisions and methodological updates are documented and cited in subsequent releases.

candidates.title: Economically Active Population Survey (경제활동인구조사)
candidates.description: Monthly household survey that measures the labour force, employment, unemployment and non-participation, with detailed breakdowns by age, sex, industry, occupation and employment status. Korea’s official labour-force statistics.
candidates.notes: Core labour-market indicator. Provides the official unemployment rate and employment figures used in macroeconomic analysis, social policy and international comparisons (ILO concepts). Parallel to Japan’s Labour Force Survey.

candidates.title: Household Income and Expenditure Survey (가계동향조사 / related household income surveys)
candidates.description: Periodic household survey measuring income, expenditure, consumption patterns and living conditions. Source for distributional analysis, poverty-related indicators and the weights of the CPI basket.
candidates.notes: Key source for living standards, inequality and consumption analysis. Complements the labour-force and price series and feeds into national-accounts household-sector estimates.

candidates.title: Korean System of National Accounts / GDP and related aggregates (국민계정)
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts compiled by the Bank of Korea in accordance with international standards (SNA). Includes GDP by production, expenditure and income approaches, institutional-sector accounts, and related aggregates.
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic framework. BOK is the primary compiler of the Korean System of National Accounts. Continuously used for growth analysis, fiscal and monetary policy, and international comparisons. Parallel to Japan’s JSNA (CAO/ESRI) node.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position
candidates.description: Monthly / quarterly balance-of-payments statistics and related external accounts compiled according to BPM6. Includes current account, capital and financial account, and international investment position.
candidates.notes: Primary external-sector statistics. Closely watched given Korea’s export-oriented economy and large current-account swings. Links to trade statistics and to national-accounts external transactions.

candidates.title: Monthly Survey of Mining and Manufacturing (광업제조업동향조사) / Industrial Production Index
candidates.description: Monthly survey of production, shipments and inventories in mining and manufacturing, used to compile the Index of Industrial Production and related short-term indicators.
candidates.notes: Key short-term activity indicator for Korea’s manufacturing-heavy economy (semiconductors, autos, shipbuilding, etc.). Parallel to Japan’s Current Survey of Production / IIP cluster.

candidates.title: KOSIS — Korean Statistical Information Service (국가통계포털)
candidates.description: Central online portal and dissemination platform for official statistics produced by KOSTAT and other agencies. Provides searchable access to time series, census results, and statistical publications.
candidates.notes: Infrastructure node analogous to Japan’s e-Stat. The practical gateway through which most official Korean statistics are accessed and cited.

candidates.title: Bank of Korea (한국은행) — statistical function
candidates.description: Central bank with primary responsibility for national accounts, flow of funds, balance of payments, monetary and financial statistics, and related macroeconomic indicators. Complements KOSTAT in the production of official economic statistics.
referenced_by: Korean System of National Accounts releases
Balance of Payments and monetary statistics
Monetary-policy reports and financial-stability assessments that rely on BOK statistical series
candidates.notes: Institutional node. In Korea the division of labour between KOSTAT (many survey-based and demographic statistics) and BOK (national accounts, BOP, monetary) is a defining feature of the statistical system, parallel to the SBJ–BOJ / CAO division in Japan.

candidates.title: Producer Price Index (생산자물가지수)
candidates.description: Monthly index of prices received by domestic producers for their output. Complements the CPI as the main producer-side inflation measure.
candidates.notes: Important for national-accounts deflation, margin analysis and understanding cost-push pressures in Korea’s export-oriented manufacturing sector. Parallel to Japan’s CGPI.
